lines.trans: Good day, Pavel. I am Panov.
I greet you. Did all our people gather?
Yes, all the partners are already here.
The entire agreed sum is located here.
There are exactly six large bags here.
I have completely fulfilled my part of the deal.
Now all this money is yours.
It is very pleasant doing business with you!
Can we already load the bags right now?
Yes, of course, start loading quickly.
We still have a press conference today.
Wonderful, this is only the very beginning of the work.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
to fulfil, to keep, to carry out
meanings.note: an order, promise, or part of a deal

examples.trans: I kept my part of the deal.

meanings.note: put items onto a vehicle or into bags

examples.trans: We are carefully loading all the money.
The workers were loading bags into the truck.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер
mostly in set phrases: иметь совесть, иметь право = to have the right; everyday 'I have' is у меня есть

examples.trans: You have the right to remain silent.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

находиться.gloss: to be located, to be found

meanings.en: to be located, to be situated

examples.trans: Where is the operating room located?
The town is situated on a river.
At the beginning of the week.
I love our town very much.

meanings.en: partner, associate in business or activity

examples.trans: I am the most reliable partner.

Marina Sergeyevna has paid off the debt in full.

meanings.note: Я прекрасно понимаю = I understand perfectly
first part пресс- does not decline

examples.trans: The press conference will be this evening.

meanings.note: ровно десять секунд = exactly ten seconds

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.
